children: Biohaven paused new U.S. patient enrollment in its BHV-7000 program after an FDA partial clinical hold while dosing continues for already randomized patients.
FDA issued a partial clinical hold (Sept 4, 2026) pausing new U.S. enrollment pending additional nonclinical metabolite data.
Dosing continues for all >600 randomized patients across the BHV-7000 program; BHV7000-303 is fully enrolled and dosing ongoing.
Topline data for BHV7000-303 remains on track for H2 2026 despite the partial hold on new enrollment.
Biohaven licensed its Kv7 platform, including BHV-7000, to SK Biopharmaceuticals; HSR filing underway and SKBP received full disclosure of clinical and nonclinical data.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
